1.title: 概覽
content: 「致所有捍衛者，這裡是 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓！」![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓在我們每次啟動初代《鬥陣特攻》時都會這樣問候我們，且自那時起，他一直是表現最出色的突擊型坦克之一。對於資深玩家來說，許多人尚未適應影響了 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓、他的遊玩風格以及他所謂的剋星等眾多平衡性改動。舉例來說，自從上次護甲改動後，![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓在面對像是 ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)死神、![](/data/assets/guide/9836801e140c9b2a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbastion.png)壁壘機兵 和 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 等英雄時也能存活下來，因此「猴子」玩家不應該僅僅因為敵方陣容中有這些英雄就輕易更換角色。

簡單易懂卻難以精通的技能組，賦予了 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓較低的入門門檻，但同時也擁有極高的操作上限。主要攻擊方式擁有非常寬廣的範圍傷害（AoE），這意味著你不需要精準的槍法也能用 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓打出好表現。與這位天才 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓相似，![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓的玩家必須先培養自己的大腦與遊戲意識，才能穩定發揮。他可以突然出現在地圖上的任何位置，因此敵人必須時刻保持警覺，隨時準備應對他的突襲。當你想打得更有侵略性時，試試 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓，並開始繞過整個敵方隊伍，鎖定那些脆弱的後排角色吧。

1.1.1.title: 遊玩方式
content: * 避免與坦克交戰。![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓在與其他任何坦克的 1 對 1 決鬥中都會落敗。請遠離他們。

* 不要待在隘口。短射程和極低的傷害減免能力，使![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓不擅長爭奪隘口。請利用躍擊（Leap）繞過隘口，前往側襲角度或高處。

* 尋找落單的突襲目標。每當你看到敵人與隊伍稍微分離時，就使用![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)噴射背包（Jump Pack）跳向他們，並嘗試快速將其擊殺。

1.1.2.title: 對抗策略
content: * 追蹤他的冷卻時間。當 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓使用防護力場或噴射跳躍時，敵人會有相當充裕的時間來攻擊他，因為他無法立即施放護盾或跳走。趁他無法脫身時集火攻擊他。

* 保持距離。大多數英雄都擁有控場技能（CC）來阻止或擊退 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓，或是利用位移技能逃離。盡量不要讓他靠近，因為他只有在近距離時才具備威脅性。

* 保持在友方醫護兵（Support）的視野範圍內。![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓的傷害相對較低，大多數醫護兵（Support）即便在他攻擊你的同時，也能透過治療讓你存活。最終，你造成的傷害會高於他，他將被迫撤退。

2.title: 優缺點總結
content: * 快速跳躍（Fast jump）
* 擅長孤立目標
* 穿透護盾的劈砍攻擊（Barrier piercing cleave）
* 低傷害
* 低冷卻循環
* 許多不利的對戰組合

3.1.1.title: 極速跳躍
content: 噴射跳躍（Jump Pack）能讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓飛越地圖，是《鬥陣特攻》中移動速度最快的技能之一。他利用這種卓越的速度來追擊敵人，並迫使他們必須展現出色的操作技巧，否則就只能面臨死亡。無論是佔領高處還是直接跳向後排，![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)噴射跳躍（Jump Pack）所帶來的傷害與速度，都是 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓技能組的核心。

3.1.2.title: 孤立敵人
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓擅長偵查，並能跳向與隊伍脫節的敵人。除此之外，他還擁有 ![](/data/assets/guide/3320e3b9cbd5d84c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-projector.png)屏障產生器（Barrier Projector），能將敵人與其隊伍徹底隔絕。敵方隊伍無法穿過屏障進行射擊或治療，這讓他和隊友能夠迅速擊殺被孤立的目標。

3.1.3.title: 穿透護盾的範圍傷害
content: 除了近戰攻擊外，![](/data/assets/guide/6e13dbd3b63c0f90.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftesla-cannon.png)特斯拉加農砲（Tesla Cannon）的主要攻擊是唯一能穿透護盾的攻擊方式。此外，該光束的廣角範圍能對範圍內的所有敵人造成劈砍傷害。這使得 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓能夠同時對多名敵人造成傷害，並更快累積絕招能量。

3.2.1.title: 每秒傷害過低
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓（Winston）有時難以取得擊殺，單純是因為他的每秒傷害太低，無法在目標受到治療時穩定將其擊殺。這種低傷害是他不擅長與戰士（Bruiser）單挑的主要原因之一。對手擊殺他的速度遠比他擊殺對手的速度快得多。

3.2.2.title: 長冷卻循環
content: 與其他突進型坦克相比，![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓重新部署位置的頻率較低。他只有一個位移技能，且其冷卻時間比例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va 的 ![](/data/assets/guide/390fb173c801c718.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fboosters.png)推進器（Boosters）還要長。![](/data/assets/guide/3320e3b9cbd5d84c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-projector.png)屏障產生器（Barrier Projector）長達 12 秒的冷卻時間更容易遭到對手針對。該屏障的生命值通常只能維持幾秒鐘，導致兩次使用屏障之間會出現很長的空窗期。

3.2.3.title: 深受對戰組合影響
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓在特定對戰中能做什麼以及應該嘗試做什麼，很大程度上取決於敵方的隊伍陣容。當敵方擁有缺乏機動性的後排時，他可以輕鬆跳向他們；但如果後排擁有暈眩（Stuns）和控場（CC）技能，他可能會在跳躍過程中被擊退，或是被暈眩致死。同樣的原則適用於所有角色。![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓比起其他坦克，更被迫需要根據敵方陣容的英雄選擇來調整他的遊玩風格與策略。

4.1.title: 主要攻擊：特斯拉砲（Tesla Cannon）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/6e13dbd3b63c0f90.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftesla-cannon.png)特斯拉砲（Tesla Cannon）的使用技巧**
* 屏障與減傷技能

* * 大多數時候，![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓不該與擁有屏障的英雄交戰，因此你應該只在戰鬥初期利用此特性，或是用來擊殺那些為了保命而開啟護盾的殘血敵人。

* 範例：敵方 ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)席格馬生命值很低，但仍有屏障與 ![](/data/assets/guide/7486123dd5edc842.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkinetic-grasp.png)動能補捉（Kinetic Grasp）來保命。![](/data/assets/guide/6e13dbd3b63c0f90.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftesla-cannon.png)特斯拉砲（Tesla Cannon）可以無視這兩者，並在隊友無法擊殺時解決該 ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)席格馬。
* 大範圍擴散傷害
* * 盡量讓多名敵人保持在你的光束範圍內。你可以透過橫向移動（strafe）並調整準心，讓攻擊更多目標變得更容易。
* 近戰交織（Melee weave）
* * 每當你處於近戰範圍時，應該交替使用近戰攻擊與主要攻擊。隨著時間推移，由於減少了裝填時間，你將能對單一目標造成更高的傷害。

4.2.title: 次要攻擊：特斯拉加農砲（蓄力）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/6e13dbd3b63c0f90.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftesla-cannon.png)特斯拉加農砲（蓄力）使用技巧**
* 消耗性傷害（Poke damage）
* 在每場戰鬥爆發前，你可以使用次要攻擊來累積部分絕招蓄力，並對敵人施加輕微的消耗性壓力。
* 當敵隊擁有高額消耗性傷害，且探頭造成 60 點傷害卻會讓你損失數百點生命值時，最好不要探頭或進行消耗。
* 跳躍連招

* 開始蓄力次要攻擊，使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)跳躍背包，在空中開火以在落地前造成傷害。這項技術能增加你的爆發傷害，並有助於確保擊殺。

* 無需使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)跳躍背包的射程

* 通常敵人生命值極低時會試圖逃跑。你可以使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)跳躍背包去追擊他們，但如果他們的血量低到足以被蓄力光束擊殺，請直接射擊並保留跳躍技能。

4.3.title: [SHIFT]：噴射跳躍（Jump Pack）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)噴射跳躍（Jump Pack）技巧**
* 爭奪高地

* ![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)噴射跳躍（Jump Pack）最大的優勢在於爭奪高地的能力。當你使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓（Winston）時，絕不能讓敵方的輸出（DPS）和支援（Supports）輕易佔據高地。跳上去，利用你的生命值和屏障來承受傷害，並對他們造成足夠的威脅，迫使他們撤退。
* 優先考慮生存

* 在沒有 ![](/data/assets/guide/3320e3b9cbd5d84c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-projector.png)屏障產生器（Barrier Projector）的情況下，絕對不要使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)噴射跳躍（Jump Pack）衝入敵陣。![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)噴射跳躍（Jump Pack）的冷卻時間比 ![](/data/assets/guide/3320e3b9cbd5d84c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-projector.png)屏障產生器（Barrier Projector）快上一倍，所以要小心，不要因為沒有屏障保護而跳入敵陣導致瞬間死亡。
* 跳躍距離

* ![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)噴射跳躍（Jump Pack）的方向是可以控制的。按住前進鍵可以跳得更遠，按住後退鍵則可以進行短距離跳躍。
* 跳躍目標優先級

* 學習使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓（Winston）最重要的一點，就是學會判斷該跳向誰。以下是一份簡要的檢查清單，幫助你在任何對戰中決定跳躍的目標。

* 對隊伍的威脅：![](/data/assets/guide/0df66e1c25a77a79.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsojourn.png)索潔恩（Sojourn）正在施放絕招並滑行進入你們隊伍尋找擊殺機會。立即對她使用噴射跳躍。即使無法擊殺她，你的存在也能讓隊友更有機會存活。

* 落單目標：![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)禪亞塔（Zenyatta）獨自站在側翼，試圖用滿蓄力的充能射擊偷襲你們的後排。趁他落單時跳向他，輕鬆取得擊殺。

* 已使用反制技能：![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)拉瑪塔（Ramattra）剛結束 ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)復仇型態（Nemesis Form）。他的原始型態對你威脅不大，且你可以穿透他的屏障造成傷害。這是唯一適合跳向 ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)拉瑪塔（Ramattra）的時機。

* 無位移能力：你看到 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西（Ashe）使用了 ![](/data/assets/guide/aa1e1fee6005660a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoach-gun.png)教練槍（Coach Gun）。跳向她落地的位置，因為你知道她無法再將你擊退或逃脫。

* 無法擊破你的屏障：![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)小美（Mei）正壓制你們的隊伍。只要敵方隊伍的其他成員正忙於應付其他人，你就可以跳向她。她無法擊破你的屏障，你可以透過「屏障舞」（bubble dance）來贏得單挑。

4.4.title: [E]：屏障產生器（Barrier Projector）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/3320e3b9cbd5d84c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-projector.png)屏障產生器（Barrier Projector）的使用技巧
* 阻擋控場技能

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/3320e3b9cbd5d84c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-projector.png)屏障產生器（Barrier Projector）最重要的用途就是阻擋暈眩和擊退效果。你可以完美抓準時機突襲落單的敵方 ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜，但如果你沒有擋下她的 ![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)睡眠鏢（Sleep Dart），她就會逃脫，而你反而很可能會被丟擲生化手榴彈（Biotic Grenade）並因此陣亡。
* 一旦你開始阻擋敵方的控場技能，預期他們會改變施放時機。這時就變成了雙方心理戰，看誰能更精準地預判對方的動作。
* 泡泡舞（Bubble dance）
* * 如果你打算花時間進行正面交戰，你就必須精通「泡泡舞」：
* * 站在泡泡邊緣，當敵人在外側時走進去。當他們試圖走進來時，就走出去，藉此持續阻擋他們的攻擊。

* 根據對戰組合的不同，你可以學習對手攻擊的節奏來提升效率。例如，![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)攔路豬的散彈槍射速較慢，你可以抓準節奏來進行泡泡舞，藉此反制他的射擊頻率，讓你永遠不會受到完整一發散彈的傷害。
* 切斷視線（LoS）
* * 有時候，屏障產生器（Bubble）的最佳用途是將敵人與其隊伍的資源隔絕開來。這可以用來阻止生命值偏低的萊因哈特獲得治療，或是放置屏障來阻斷音波屏障（Sound Barrier）的範圍效果。
* 掩護隊友（Peel）

* * 雖然 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓不見得是掩護隊友的最佳坦克，但他絕對有能力做到。當你看到隊友陷入生命危險時，跳向他們並放下屏障來保住他們的性命。
* 許多絕招都可以透過時機精準的屏障來存活。在隊伍上方放下屏障，為他們爭取反制敵方絕招的時間。

4.5.title: 絕招：原始暴怒（Primal Rage）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)原始暴怒（Primal Rage）的使用技巧**
* 額外生命

* * 當會戰仍有勝算且你即將陣亡時，開啟 ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)原始暴怒（Primal Rage）來獲得瞬間的生命值恢復。這基本上等於讓你多了一條命，僅僅是存活下來就能扭轉會戰局勢。
* 隨時留意存活的玩家人數，如果你的隊伍在人數上已經嚴重落後，請保留你的絕招。
* 消耗敵方資源

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)原始暴怒（Primal Rage）能讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓（Winston）在會戰中全力投入。在許多戰鬥中，這將決定敵方後排是會殘血存活，還是被你徹底擊殺。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓（Winston）最初的突進（Dive）通常會用來交換敵方的冷卻技能，隨後便可在沒有這些技能威脅的情況下使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)原始暴怒（Primal Rage）。這能讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓（Winston）利用 ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)原始暴怒（Primal Rage）取得原本無法擊殺的目標。

* 如果敵方擁有反制手段，請不要使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)原始暴怒（Primal Rage）。

* * 攔路豬（Roadhog）的火力全開（Whole Hog）、安娜（Ana）的睡眠鏢（Sleep Dart）、札莉雅（Zarya）的重力噴湧（Graviton Surge）以及其他類似技能，都能輕易壓制這隻憤怒巨猿的巨大身軀。請等待這些技能使用過後，再投入 ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)原始暴怒（Primal Rage）。
* 擊飛連段（Juggles）

* * 精通 ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)原始暴怒（Primal Rage）的最終階段就是擊飛連段機制。這是他絕招中最困難且最華麗的部分。花點時間在訓練模式中習慣近戰擊退的距離，以及為了維持連段，你需要跳躍多遠的距離。
* 牆壁、角落和狹小的房間都能讓擊飛連段變得容易許多。將敵人困在地形邊緣，按住攻擊鍵，並在冷卻時間結束時立即跳躍，以最大化傷害輸出。
* 在空中時向下看，以便在跳躍過程中擊中敵人，並將他們帶往你想要的方向。

5.1.1.title: 帶電（Electric Charge）
5.1.1.description: 溫斯頓（Winston）每對一名敵人造成主要攻擊傷害，移動速度便會提升 10%，最高可達 30%。
content: * 當對手試圖從你的突襲中逃脫時，這是追擊敵人的絕佳選擇。
* 與重型著陸（Heavy Landing）相比，此特殊能力（perk）能為你提供更穩定的價值。

* 當敵人擁有速度增益能力，或是你對 ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)原始暴怒（Primal Rage）的擊飛連段沒有信心時，此能力效果最佳。

5.1.2.title: 重力降臨（Heavy Landing）
5.1.2.description: 在原始暴怒（Primal Rage）期間，跳躍背包（Jump Pack）的傷害與範圍在滯空時最多可增加 75%。
content: * 最佳次要特殊能力（minor perks）

* 在 ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)原始暴怒（Primal Rage）期間提升致命性

* * 每當你在 ![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)原始暴怒（Primal Rage）期間使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)跳躍背包（Jump Pack），你將造成更高的爆發傷害。額外的傷害對於擊殺轉換非常有幫助，效果令人驚艷。
* 你在空中停留的時間越長，資源計量條填滿的程度就越高，落地時造成的傷害也越大。
* 一般來說，最好只在初始攻擊時進行高跳，之後保持跳躍低而快速即可。

5.2.1.title: 連鎖閃電（Chain Lightning）
5.2.1.description: 完全蓄力的次要攻擊命中後，會彈跳至最多 2 個額外目標。
content: * 額外絕招蓄力

* 連鎖閃電在命中 2 個額外敵人時會造成額外 72 點傷害。與單次命中造成的 48 點傷害相比，![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓（Winston）每次次要攻擊所產生的絕招蓄力是原本的 2.5 倍。
* 取得最後一擊的潛力
* 只要在範圍內有可鎖定的隊友，彈跳效果就能擊中掩體後的敵人。如果敵人處於殘血狀態，你或許能藉此取得最後一擊。

5.2.2.title: 活化屏障（Revitalizing Barrier）
5.2.2.description: 屏障產生器（Barrier Projector）會為範圍內的盟友每秒恢復 30 點生命值。
content: * 自我治療
* * 即使在與敵人進行屏障拉扯（bubble dancing）時，短短幾秒的治療量也足以決定你是贏得交戰還是存活撤退。
* 額外絕招充能

* * 屏障持續期間總共可為內部的每位英雄恢復 240 點生命值。你與盟友所獲得的治療量會產生絕招充能。當你需要為戰鬥累積 ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)原始暴怒（Primal Rage）時，你可以將屏障用於防禦並治療你的盟友。

6.title: 地圖
content: 最適合 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓的地圖通常具備建築結構、高地以及充足的天然掩體。![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓不希望僅僅依賴他的 ![](/data/assets/guide/3320e3b9cbd5d84c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-projector.png)屏障產生器（Barrier Projector）作為唯一的生存手段。相反地，當地圖環境能提供保護時，他的表現最為出色。跳上高地將敵人擊退是他的拿手好戲。高地也讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓能夠在發動突襲前先行佈陣，並在不使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)噴射跳躍（Jump Pack）的情況下直接跳向敵人。如此一來，他就能在需要時隨時跳離戰場。
溫斯頓在那些寬闊且掩體稀少的地圖上會感到吃力。此外，那些偏好在目標點進行近距離交戰的地圖對他來說也相當棘手，因為在這些環境下，他更難以避開那些對他不利的對戰組合。

7.title: 隊伍陣容搭配
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓（Winston）本身缺乏致命的爆發傷害。如果他的目標正在接受治療，他通常無法完成擊殺。溫斯頓的強項在於干擾後排，並為隊友創造機會，讓他們能跟上他的突進。

能夠跟上![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)跳躍背包（Jump Pack）速度的英雄是最佳搭檔。例如像![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)源氏、![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)閃光和![](/data/assets/guide/52c34367e459b0af.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fvendetta.png)宿怨這類具備機動性的爆發傷害英雄。他們可以聯手重創敵方後排。

在輔助方面，溫斯頓需要高額的單體治療，這樣他才能在撤退後迅速恢復生命值，並立即重返戰場。搭配像![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜或![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子這樣的輔助英雄，能讓他打得更具侵略性，在遠距離獲得治療，並透過她們的功能性冷卻技能獲得保命。

8.title: 如何反制
content: 反制 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓最有效的方法，就是阻止他從戰鬥中跳走。他基本的遊戲循環是跳入戰場、放下屏障、攻擊、跳走，然後重複上述過程。如果你能阻止他跳走，他必死無疑（或者你會逼出像 ![](/data/assets/guide/d2ebbaa1842e11ad.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsound-barrier.png)音波屏障這樣的輔助絕招來救他）。

諸如 ![](/data/assets/guide/52c34367e459b0af.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fvendetta.png)宿怨（Vendetta）過頂、![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch）、![](/data/assets/guide/4430a4dc25f88f5c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fravenous-vortex.png)飢餓漩渦（Ravenous Vortex）、![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)睡眠鏢（Sleep Dart）以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/61a533467bf9f01d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbinding-chain.png)束縛之鏈（Binding Chain）等技能，只要時機掌握得當，都是強力的反制手段。
最後，請記住，如果你沒有逃生技能，就必須待在能保護你的隊友身邊——無論是透過高爆發治療，還是足以逼退溫斯頓的傷害輸出。

* 專業提示：不要下意識地切換成 ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)死神。這種反制選擇是過去留下的觀念，卻在現代玩家群體中根深蒂固。雖然他的散彈槍對這隻「猴子」能造成高額傷害，但那僅限於近距離且溫斯頓沒有 ![](/data/assets/guide/3320e3b9cbd5d84c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-projector.png)屏障產生器（Barrier Projector）保護自己的情況下。如果溫斯頓玩家具備一定水準，這種情況很少發生。請記住，對戰組合並非一成不變；你必須隨時留意地圖、遊戲模式以及敵方隊伍的其他成員。

8.2.title: 特定英雄剋制名稱
content: 毀滅拳王
安娜
